paite: Huan Samuel asita a; Israel mi tengteng ahong paikhawm ua, amah kah in Ramah ah a-inn uah avui uhi. David athou a Paran gamdai ah ahohsuk hi.
heading: Samuel Sihna
english: Samuel died; and all Israel gathered themselves together and mourned for him, and buried him at his house at Ramah. Then David arose and went down to the wilderness of Paran.

paite: Maon ah mi khat a-om a, Karmel tang ah aneih-le-lam a-om hi. Amah mithupitak ahi a, belam sangthum leh kel sangkhat anei hi. Karmel tang ah abelam mul amet hi.
heading: David Leh Abigail
english: There was a man in Maon whose possessions were in Carmel; and the man was very great. He had three thousand sheep and a thousand goats; and he was shearing his sheep in Carmel.

paite: Amin Nabal ahi a, azi min Abigail ahi. Huai numei teitak leh melhoihtak ahi. Himahleh pasal pen mi chihhaktak leh giloutak ahi a; amah Kaleb suan ahi.
english: Now the name of the man was Nabal; and the name of his wife Abigail. This woman was intelligent and had a beautiful face; but the man was surly and evil in his doings. He was of the house of Caleb.

paite: David in gamdai a pan Nabal in abelam mul amet chih ana za hi.
english: David heard in the wilderness that Nabal was shearing his sheep.

paite: Huchi in David in tangval sawm asawl a, tangvalte kiang ah, "David in Karmel tang ah va hohtou unla, Nabal kiang ah hoh unla ka min in chibai va buk un.
english: David sent ten young men; and David said to the young men, “Go up to Carmel, and go to Nabal, and greet him in my name.

paite: Mineizoupa kiang ah huchi in va chi un: 'Nang tung ah, na inkuante tung ah leh na neih tengteng tung ah khamuanna om hen.
english: Tell him, ‘Long life to you! Peace be to you! Peace be to your house! Peace be to all that you have!

paite: Na belam mulmet mite a-om uh chih ka na za hi. Na belamching mite ka kiang ah a-om zel ua, apoi uh bangmah ka khoih kei ua, Karmel tang a a-om sung un bangmah amangsak kei uh.
english: Now I have heard that you have shearers. Your shepherds have now been with us, and we didn’t harm them. Nothing was missing from them all the time they were in Carmel.

paite: Na tangvalte dong lechin hon hilh mai ding uh. Huchi in hiai ka tangvalte'n na mitmuh in deihsakna tang uhen, ni hoih ni tak a hong hoh lah ka hi ngal ua. Na neih bangbang na sikhate leh na tapa David na pe dih ve, achi, chi un, " achi hi.
english: Ask your young men, and they will tell you. Therefore let the young men find favor in your eyes, for we come on a good day. Please give whatever comes to your hand to your servants and to your son David.’”

paite: David tangvalte ava tun un David min in huai thu tengteng Nabal kiang ah agen ua, huchi in adaita uh.
english: When David’s young men came, they spoke to Nabal all those words in the name of David, and waited.

paite: Nabal in David sikhate adawng a, "David kua ahia oi? Jesse tapa kua ahia oi? Tulai in sikha tampi pute taimangsan atam mai uh.
english: Nabal answered David’s servants and said, “Who is David? Who is the son of Jesse? There are many servants who break away from their masters these days.

paite: Ka tanghou, ka tui leh ka belam mulmet mite a dia ka gohsa kuate ahi ua chih ka theihlouhte ka pe peuhmah dia hia?" achi hi.
english: Shall I then take my bread, my water, and my meat that I have killed for my shearers, and give it to men who I don’t know where they come from?”

paite: Huchi in David tangvalte akihei ua, akik nawn ua; huai thu tengteng ahong hilh uh.
english: So David’s young men turned on their way and went back, and came and told him all these words.

paite: David in amite kiang ah, "Na namsau uh kuah chiat un," achi hi. Anamsau uh akuah chiat uh. David in leng anamsau akuah a, mi zali in David azuitou ua; mi zanih van veng in a-om uhi.
english: David said to his men, “Every man put on his sword!” Every man put on his sword. David also put on his sword. About four hundred men followed David, and two hundred stayed by the baggage.

paite: Tangval khat in Nabal zi Abigail kiang ah, "Ngai in, David in gamdai a pan ka pu uh chibai buk ding in mi ahon sawl a, ama'n ana sal hi.
english: But one of the young men told Abigail, Nabal’s wife, saying, “Behold, David sent messengers out of the wilderness to greet our master; and he insulted them.

paite: Himahleh huaite lah ka tung uah ahoih mahmah ua, ka poi uh bangmah akhoih kei uh. Gamlak a ka om lai ua ka omkhawm sung tengteng uh bangmah ka tan kei uhi.
english: But the men were very good to us, and we were not harmed, and we didn’t miss anything as long as we went with them, when we were in the fields.

paite: Belamching a akiang ua ka om sung tengteng un sun leh zan kou a ding in baang ahi mai uhi.
english: They were a wall to us both by night and by day, all the while we were with them keeping the sheep.

paite: Huaiziak in bang ahia na hih ding hoihtak in ngaihtuah dih ve. Ka pu uh tung ah leh a-inkuan tengteng tung ah thil hoih lou tup in anei hi. Amah lah a Belial tapa mahmah a, kuamah houpih theih ahi kei hi," chi in agen hi.
english: Now therefore know and consider what you will do; for evil is determined against our master and against all his house, for he is such a worthless fellow that one can’t speak to him.”

paite: Abigail in kintak in tanghou beu zanih, uain thawl nih, belam nga huan dia mansa, vaimim kan buk nga, grep gah phoukeu bawk zakhat leh theipi beu zanih alakhawm a, sabiltung aposak hi.
english: Then Abigail hurried and took two hundred loaves of bread, two containers of wine, five sheep ready dressed, five seahs of parched grain, one hundred clusters of raisins, and two hundred cakes of figs, and laid them on donkeys.

paite: Asikha tangvalte kiang ah, "Ka ma ah na pai zel unla, ngai un, ka hon zui ding," achi hi. Himahleh apasal Nabal ahilh kei hi.
english: She said to her young men, “Go on before me. Behold, I am coming after you.” But she didn’t tell her husband, Nabal.

paite: Huchi in hichibang ahi a, asabiltung tung a tuang a tang sang sing lak a apaisuk lai in, ngai in, David leh amite'n ahon zuan ua, huchi in amau atuakta hi.
english: As she rode on her donkey, and came down hidden by the mountain, behold, David and his men came down toward her, and she met them.

paite: David in, "Bangmah amansaklouhna dia gamdai a hiai mipa neih tengteng athawn lel in ka na vensak ana hi mahmah ve; thil hoih lah thil hoih lou in ahon dinta ngal a.
english: Now David had said, “Surely in vain I have kept all that this fellow has in the wilderness, so that nothing was missed of all that pertained to him. He has returned me evil for good.

paite: Zingchiang zingsang khovak pha a amah a tengteng lak a pasal naupang khat kia lel leng ka hawi peuhmahleh Pathian in David melmate thupizaw sem in bawl hen,” achi hi.
english: God do so to the enemies of David, and more also, if I leave of all that belongs to him by the morning light so much as one who urinates on a wall.”

paite: Abigail in David amuh in asabiltung a pan akumsuk zok a, David ma a lei si in akunsuk hi.
english: When Abigail saw David, she hurried and got off her donkey, and fell before David on her face and bowed herself to the ground.

paite: Akhebul ah abokkhup a, "Keimah in, ka toupa aw, kei mahmah in thulimlouhna ka khu ding. Na sikhanu'n na bil a zak ding in thu gen henla, na sikhanu thugen hehpih in ngaikhia in.
english: She fell at his feet and said, “On me, my lord, on me be the blame! Please let your servant speak in your ears. Hear the words of your servant.

paite: Ka toupa aw, Belial mi Nabal bangmah in sim ke'n. Amin bangbang ahi geih hi. Nabal ahi na mah a, ahai hi. Kei na sikhanu'n, ka toupa'n na hon sawl tangvalte ka na mu kha kei hi.
english: Please don’t let my lord pay attention to this worthless fellow, Nabal, for as his name is, so is he. Nabal is his name, and folly is with him; but I, your servant, didn’t see my lord’s young men whom you sent.

paite: Huaiziak in tu in, toupa aw, TOUPA hinna leh na hin bang in ka gen ahi. Ka mu mahmah kei hi, TOUPA'N sisan suah lou ding leh na khut a phu la lou ding in lah nang ahon bawl hi. Na melmate leh ka toupa hoihlouhna zong mite Nabal bang himai uhen.
english: Now therefore, my lord, as Yahweh lives and as your soul lives, since Yahweh has withheld you from blood guiltiness and from avenging yourself with your own hand, now therefore let your enemies and those who seek evil to my lord be as Nabal.

paite: Hiai ka toupa a dia na sikha in vualzawlnate ka hon tawi ka pu hon zui tangvalte piak hi hen.
english: Now this present which your servant has brought to my lord, let it be given to the young men who follow my lord.

paite: Na sikhanu tatlekna hehpih in ngaidam in. TOUPA'N ka toupa inkuan kiptak in aphut ngeingei dia, ka pu TOUPA kidounate dou ahi ngal a. Na damsung teng in nangmah gitlouh man muh ding a-om kei ding.
english: Please forgive the trespass of your servant. For Yahweh will certainly make my lord a sure house, because my lord fights Yahweh’s battles. Evil will not be found in you all your days.

paite: Nang hon delh ding leh na hinna hihmang ding in mite hong kisa mah le uh, ka toupa hinna zaw TOUPA na Pathian toh hinna a gak ahi dia; na melmate hinna bel vaisuanglot a suanglot bang in alawnmang ding hi.
english: Though men may rise up to pursue you and to seek your soul, yet the soul of my lord will be bound in the bundle of life with Yahweh your God. He will sling out the souls of your enemies as from a sling’s pocket.

paite: Huan hichi ahi ding a, TOUPA'N na tungtang thu a thil hoih a chiam bang teng ka toupa tung a ahih chiang a, Israelte kumpipa dia ahon bawl chiang in,
english: It will come to pass, when Yahweh has done to my lord according to all the good that he has spoken concerning you, and has appointed you prince over Israel,

paite: Aziak om lou a sisan na suah louh a, ka toupa'n phu na lak louh nang a ding in lungkhamna himhim ahi kei ding. Ka toupa a ding in leng lungkimlouhna himhim ahi sam kei ding. TOUPA'N ka toupa tung a thil hoih ahih hun chiang in na sikhanu theigige in," achi hi.
english: that this shall be no grief to you, nor offense of heart to my lord, either that you have shed blood without cause, or that my lord has avenged himself. When Yahweh has dealt well with my lord, then remember your servant.”

paite: David in Abigail kiang ah, "Tuni a kei hon na dawn dia hon sawlpa TOUPA, Israelte' Pathian phat in om hen.
english: David said to Abigail, “Blessed is Yahweh, the God of Israel, who sent you today to meet me!

paite: Na lemtheihna vualzawl in om henla, nang sisan suah mohna a pan hon humnu leh keimah khut a phu la lou dia hon bawlnu vualzawl in om hen.
english: Blessed is your discretion, and blessed are you, who have kept me today from blood guiltiness, and from avenging myself with my own hand.

paite: Kei hon dawn dia hong pawtkhe pah lou hi lechin, TOUPA, Israelte' Pathian ahin bang in ka gen ahi, zingchiang khovak pha in Nabal ka hawisak het kei ding," achi hi.
english: For indeed, as Yahweh the God of Israel lives, who has withheld me from harming you, unless you had hurried and come to meet me, surely there wouldn’t have been left to Nabal by the morning light so much as one who urinates on a wall.”

paite: Huchi in David in athiltawite ala a, akiang ah, "Lungmuangtak in na inn ah paitouta in. Na thu ka mang hi. Na nget nen ka hon sansak hi,” achi hi.
english: So David received from her hand that which she had brought him. Then he said to her, “Go up in peace to your house. Behold, I have listened to your voice and have granted your request.”

paite: Nabal kiang ah Abigail ahohtou hi. Ngai in, a-inn ah kumpipa ankuanglui bang mai in ankuang a na lui hi. Akham mahmah ziak in Nabal amaitai ngial hi. Huaiziak in azingsang khovak masiah bangmah ahilh kei hi.
english: Abigail came to Nabal; and behold, he held a feast in his house like the feast of a king. Nabal’s heart was merry within him, for he was very drunk. Therefore she told him nothing until the morning light.

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, zinglam a Nabal uain kham ahong halh in azi in huai thute ahilhta a, alung adaiduak a, suang bang in ahong om hial hi.
english: In the morning, when the wine had gone out of Nabal, his wife told him these things; and his heart died within him, and he became as a stone.

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, ni sawm nung in TOUPA'N Nabal tung ah khut akha a, asita hi.
english: About ten days later, Yahweh struck Nabal, so that he died.

paite: David in Nabal asi chih azak in, "Ka minsiatna dia Nabal thilhih a pan hon genpih a, asikha thil hoih lou hih lou dia hon khampa TOUPA phat in om hen. Nabal thil hoih lou hih TOUPA'N amah tung mah ah akesakta," achi hi. Huchi in David in Abigail azi dia va houpih ding in mi asawl hi.
english: When David heard that Nabal was dead, he said, “Blessed is Yahweh, who has pleaded the cause of my reproach from the hand of Nabal, and has kept back his servant from evil. Yahweh has returned the evildoing of Nabal on his own head.” David sent and spoke concerning Abigail, to take her to himself as wife.

paite: David sikhate'n Karmel tang a Abigail kiang atuntouh un, "David in azi dia nang hong pi ding in ahon sawl," chi in amah ahoupih uhi.
english: When David’s servants had come to Abigail to Carmel, they spoke to her, saying, “David has sent us to you, to take you to him as wife.”

paite: Athou a, amai a lei si in akunsuk hi. "Ngai dih ua, na sikhanu uh ka toupa sikhate khe sil ding sikha ka hi," achi hi.
english: She arose and bowed herself with her face to the earth, and said, “Behold, your servant is a servant to wash the feet of the servants of my lord.”

paite: Huchi in Abigail athou zok a, sabiltung tung ah atuang a, anungzui nungak ngate toh David misawlte azui ua, azi in a-omta hi.
english: Abigail hurriedly arose and rode on a donkey with her five maids who followed her; and she went after the messengers of David, and became his wife.

paite: David in Jezreel a mi Ahinoam leng ana pi khin a; huchi in azi ding in a-om tuaktuak uhi.
english: David also took Ahinoam of Jezreel; and they both became his wives.

paite: Saul in lah atanu Mikal, David zi Gallim a mi Laish tapa Palti toh ana kitengsak zouta hi.
english: Now Saul had given Michal his daughter, David’s wife, to Palti the son of Laish, who was of Gallim.
